# Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Mixed**

Coca-Cola (KO) and PepsiCo (PEP) both exhibited revenue growth across the 2023 and 2024 fiscal periods [E4359d8e3b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E44c853c6c9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E125763497f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E4d5b87fc08](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html), while net income results varied by period [E69c62c0744](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E9f59776214](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ecf8d0d9dd4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ef5d2e089de](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Retrieved management guidance on capital expenditures was testable at the entity level and supported by later outcomes [E9905be31cf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) [E2a3813406f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), whereas strategic and risk commentary remained not testable [E19d373c4b9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) [E3404bdbe1d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm).

## Numbers on record

KO revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $47.061 billion [E44c853c6c9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $45.754 billion for 2023-12-31 [E4359d8e3b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $10.631 billion [E9f59776214](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), down from $10.714 billion for 2023-12-31 [E69c62c0744](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $2.064 billion [Ed2b060e4a3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $1.852 billion for 2023-12-31 [E2a3813406f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of March 1, 2023, historical financial statements through fiscal year 2022 were available for both Coca-Cola and PepsiCo [Ed076c53667](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [E061dedab90](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola reported expectations for 2023 capital expenditures to be approximately $1.9 billion [E9905be31cf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). PepsiCo stated it expected to return approximately $7.7 billion to shareholders in 2023, consisting of about $6.7 billion in dividends and $1.0 billion in share repurchases [E3404bdbe1d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm), while also noting operational risks in developing and emerging markets [E19d373c4b9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended 2023-12-31, Coca-Cola reported revenue of $45,754,000,000 [E4359d8e3b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), net income of $10,714,000,000 [E69c62c0744](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), and actual capital expenditures of $1,852,000,000 [E2a3813406f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). For the fiscal year ended 2024-12-31, Coca-Cola reported revenue of $47,061,000,000 [E44c853c6c9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) and net income of $10,631,000,000 [E9f59776214](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000 for its fiscal year ended 2023-12-30 [E125763497f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ecf8d0d9dd4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html), and revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 for its fiscal year ended 2024-12-28 [E4d5b87fc08](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [Ef5d2e089de](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods through the outcome cutoff, Coca-Cola's revenue for the fiscal year ended 2023-12-31 was $45,754,000,000 with net income of $10,714,000,000 [E4359d8e3b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E69c62c0744](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), and for 2024-12-31 was $47,061,000,000 with net income of $10,631,000,000 [E44c853c6c9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E9f59776214](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo utilizes a differing fiscal calendar ending on the last Saturday of December; for its fiscal year ended 2023-12-30, PepsiCo reported revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000 [E125763497f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ecf8d0d9dd4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html), and for its fiscal year ended 2024-12-28, reported revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 [E4d5b87fc08](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [Ef5d2e089de](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). PepsiCo annual USD capex is missing under supported XBRL tags [E5b96e2debc].

## Cross-examination

Coca-Cola's stated expectation of approximately $1.9 billion in 2023 capital expenditures compared closely with actual reported capex of $1.852 billion for the year ending 2023-12-31 [E9905be31cf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) [E2a3813406f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). Conversely, PepsiCo's qualitative commentary regarding risks in developing markets cannot be verified by entity-wide revenue or net income growth [E19d373c4b9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm). Management outlook statements regarding macroeconomic conditions are not guarantees and must be separated from measurable entity-wide outcomes.

## Limits

- Specific company reported segments and product-level or geographic segment subtotals for KO and PEP were not retrieved.
- PepsiCo annual USD capex is missing under supported XBRL tags.
